answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) aims at generating a valid and fluent question according to a given passage... We propose a system which consumes rich text and visual signals to arrive at an effective video representation. This, in turn, helps train a Transformer encoder-decoder model... to generate high quality ECIS questions.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance, we calculate several metrics, including BERT-Score, CIDEr, METEOR, BLEU, ROUGE, and Distinct scores.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation involving an expert with proficiency in English... The evaluator was presented with a set of 100 generated question samples ... to rate each question on a scale of 0 to 4, considering the following three criteria: (1) Context Relevance ... (2) Engagement Index ... (3) Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated question on a 0‑4 scale for Context Relevance, Engagement Index, and Fluency.
